source.figure_table: Abstract of the individual-red-cell HbF quantification paper

context.intervention: hydroxyurea (14 SCD patients; HbF measured before and during treatment)

observation.assay: Direct per-cell HbF quantification in individual red blood cells by flow cytometry (linear association between mean HbF and mean RBC fluorescence from a calibrated anti-HbF method)
observation.unit: pg HbF per RBC — protective threshold (VOC incidence decreased at the 4 pg threshold; 14 SCD patients, before and during hydroxyurea)
observation.evidence_locator: Hebert et al., Am J Hematol 95(11):1235–1245; PMID 32681733; abstract

note: Also: a significant decrease in the population of RBCs with less than 2 pg of HbF/RBC was observed during HU treatment. Distinguishes total HbF, the fraction of positive cells, directly measured per-cell HbF, and derived quantities (design-spec seed 4). G5 gives the per-cell readout; the protective threshold of 4 pg is the key observation.
